trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: kn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Greet and confirm the identity of the person answering the call.
steps.text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನಾನು college ಇಂದ call ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇನೆ. ನಾನು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ ಜೊತೆ ಮಾತಾಡಬಹುದಾ?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity and express time pressure.
steps.text: ಹೌದು, ನಾನೇ. ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಬೇಗ ಹೇಳಿ, ನನಗೆ time ಇಲ್ಲ, ಒಂದು meeting ಗೆ ಹೋಗಬೇಕು.

steps.purpose: Explain the reason for the call and ask for a verification factor.
steps.text: I understand. ನಿಮ್ಮ overdue fee ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮಾತಾಡಲು call ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೇನೆ. Verification ಗಾಗಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ date of birth confirm ಮಾಡಬಹುದಾ?

steps.purpose: Provide the requested verification factor.
Verify the customer's identity using the provided date of birth.
Return the identity verification result.
Acknowledge verification and ask the user to wait while checking fee details.
steps.text: Thank you. ನಿಮ್ಮ fee details check ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಲೈನ್ ನಲ್ಲಿರಿ.

steps.purpose: Lookup the fee account details.
Return malformed or incomplete fee account details.
Handle the malformed data gracefully without reading it out, and ask for a moment to retry.
steps.text: ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ, system ನಲ್ಲಿ details ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ load ಆಗುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ. ಒಂದು ನಿಮಿಷ time ಕೊಡ್ತೀರಾ?

steps.purpose: Reiterate time pressure and ask for a callback instead of waiting.
steps.text: ನಾನು ಮೊದಲೇ ಹೇಳಿದೆ time ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಂತ. ನಂಗೆ ಕಾಯೋಕೆ ಆಗಲ್ಲ, ನೀವೇ ಆಮೇಲೆ call back ಮಾಡಿ.

steps.purpose: Apologize for the delay and indicate that a retry is in progress immediately to prevent the user from dropping.
steps.text: ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು cut ಮಾಡಬೇಡಿ, ಈಗಷ್ಟೇ system ಬಂತು. ನಾನು ಬೇಗ details check ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.

steps.purpose: Retry the fee account lookup.
Return the correct fee account details.
State the total fee, paid amount, and due amount based on the tool result.
steps.text: Thank you for waiting. ನಿಮ್ಮ total fee 185000 ಇದೆ, ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ 60000 pay ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೀರಾ. ಬಾಕಿ due 125000 ಇದೆ.

steps.purpose: Express inability to pay the full due amount at once and request 3 instalments.
steps.text: 125000 ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಕಟ್ಟಲು ಆಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು 3 instalments ಮಾಡಿ ಕೊಡಿ. ಬೇಗ ಮಾಡಿ.

steps.purpose: Agree to set up the requested instalment plan.
steps.text: ಖಂಡಿತ, 3 instalments ಮಾಡಬಹುದು. ನಾನು ಈಗಲೇ plan setup ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ.

steps.purpose: Set up the 3-instalment plan for the outstanding due.
Return the active instalment plan details.
Confirm the instalment plan is active and state the exact per-instalment amount.
steps.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ instalment plan active ಆಗಿದೆ. ನೀವು 3 instalments ನಲ್ಲಿ pay ಮಾಡಬಹುದು, per instalment 41667 ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

steps.purpose: Ask when the first EMI needs to be paid.
Advise the user to pay as soon as possible without guaranteeing a specific date not provided by the tool.
steps.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ fee already overdue ಇರುವುದರಿಂದ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಆದಷ್ಟು ಬೇಗ first EMI pay ಮಾಡಿ.

steps.purpose: Agree to pay tomorrow and end the call.
steps.text: ಆಯ್ತು, ನಾನು ನಾಳೆ pay ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ. Thanks, bye.

ir.terminal_condition: Instalment plan active with the per-instalment amount stated from the result.
primary_variant_labels: Error Resolution > Action Failure Recovery > Invalid Tool Response

variant_findings.reason: The tool lookup_fee_account returns malformed data (-1 for all amounts) in e9. The agent handles this gracefully in e10 without reading out the invalid numbers or inventing data, and asks for a moment to retry.
variant_findings.label: Error Resolution > Action Failure Recovery > Invalid Tool Response

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds their response entirely on the tool outputs, quoting the exact fee figures in e15 and the instalment plan details in e20. In e22, the agent avoids making any unsupported forward guarantees about the specific date the first EMI is due.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e11, the user simply waits despite the persona requiring them to 'Accept a callback rather than waiting' when pressed for time. In e14, the lookup tool returns 'instalments_active: true', which makes the user's subsequent request to set up a new instalment plan illogical. Finally, in e16, there is a Kannada typo 'ಕತ್ತಲು' (which means darkness) instead of the correct word 'ಕಟ್ಟಲು' (to pay).
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite from e11. Have the user exhibit their persona by refusing to wait and explicitly asking for a callback. The agent can then immediately interject in e12 that the details just loaded, keeping the call active. In the e14 tool result, change 'instalments_active' to false so the subsequent setup makes sense. In e16, correct the spelling to 'ಕಟ್ಟಲು'.

verification.summary: The conversation correctly realizes both target variants, demonstrating good error recovery and strict grounding on tool outputs. However, it fails due to a missed persona trait (the user doesn't ask for a callback when asked to wait), a logical contradiction in the tool payload (instalments already active before being requested), and a semantic typo in the native language script.

variant_findings.reason: The lookup_fee_account tool returns incomplete and malformed data (-1 values and missing fields) in e9. The agent handles this gracefully in e10 without reading the invalid data to the user, and successfully retries the tool in e13.
variant_findings.label: Error Resolution > Action Failure Recovery > Invalid Tool Response

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly grounds its responses on the tool outputs, accurately citing the total fee, paid amount, and due amount in e15, and the per-instalment amount in e20. Furthermore, in e22, the agent avoids inventing a specific due date for the first EMI since the tool did not provide one, adhering to the 'no unsupported forward guarantee' requirement.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation is well-constructed and successfully realizes both target variants. The agent gracefully handles a malformed tool response and subsequently grounds all provided financial information strictly on valid tool outputs without making unsupported guarantees. The time-pressured persona is accurately depicted, and the Kannada-English language mix is natural and appropriate for the context.
